items.title: Why Amazon stock isn't getting bogged down by its negative free cash flow
items.summary: Amazon (AMZN) may have posted negative free cash flow in its second quarter earnings released on Thursday, but the stock is ripping up to 15% higher in Friday's session. Maxim Group managing director and senior consumer internet analyst Tom Forte dives into this phenomenon.

items.title: Apple stock plunges: CEO Tim Cook explains weak revenue forecast
items.summary: Apple (AAPL) stock is moving lower after the company's revenue forecast fell short of Wall Street's expectations. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley chats with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi about what's driving the stock and guidance lower.

items.title: Amazon stock soars after Q2 earnings beat expectations as AI, chip businesses see $25 billion run rate
items.summary: Amazon reported its Q2 earnings after the bell on Thursday.

items.title: Amazon Stock Soars As AI Strategy Sends It To 'Top Of The Cloud Wars'
items.summary: Amazon stock is racing toward its best trading day in more than a decade following its Q2 results.  A strong performance from its cloud-computing division is helping ease fears that the tech giant could lose ground to rival offerings from Microsoft and Google parent Alphabet.  "Amazon Web Services finally saw the long-awaited growth inflection, shooting to the top of the cloud wars as AI quarter-to-quarter revenue mimics Anthropic's meteoric rise," Bernstein analyst Mark Shmulik wrote to clients Friday following Amazon's report.

items.title: Why Wall Street Likes Apple's AI Strategy Despite Friday's Stock Tumble
items.summary: Apple earnings growth is picking up while largely avoiding the AI spending spree by other tech giants.

items.title: Amazon, Apple, Microsoft, Micron, Roblox, Reddit, SK Hynix, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: It’s looking like a positive end to a bad month as stocks rose Friday with the tech rebound continuing even as  Apple  decline weighed on the major indexes.  Amazon  gained 15% after second-quarter earnings and revenue comfortably beat expectations.  Alphabet  and  Meta Platforms  were both punished by the market after hiking capex this earnings season.

items.title: Today’s Dow Moves as Told by Magnificent 7 Stocks
items.summary: The Dow was caught in the middle of a Magnificent Seven earnings divergence story. The Dow was up 0.3%, or 164 points, around noon after a turbulent morning. Amazon stock popped more than 13%, while Apple slid 9.

items.title: Alphabet Jumps 6%, Reddit Craters 23% in Social Media Stock Divergence?
items.summary: Reddit just posted a beat-and-raise quarter yet its stock is cratering while Alphabet surges, and the reason why reveals a fault line running through every social media investment thesis right now.
